question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Layout
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arrangement**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Layout **means the way something is designed or arranged.

 
 
• Example -* His house has three bedrooms and ours has four, but otherwise, the **layout **is much the same.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Arrangement means an act of arranging; a state of being arranged.
 
 
• Example -* We both need to use the computer so we’ll have to come to some **arrangement**.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Layout' and 'Arrangement' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Timetable **means a list that shows the times at which something happens.
 
• **Schedule **means a plan of things that will happen or of work that must be done.
 
• **Order **means to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something or to say that something must happen.
